item_name: Rothco Cold Weather Leather Police Gloves
item_short_desc: Stay warm and protected during duty with Rothco’s Cold Weather Leather Gloves. Crafted with a soft genuine cowhide leather outer shell, these duty gloves offer exceptional durability and abrasion resistance, ensuring long-lasting performance in demanding environments.
